# Dimension 4: Alternatives Comparison

Reference file for the Todoist PA integration research.
See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## Comparison Table

| Criterion | Todoist | Trello | TickTick | Microsoft To Do |
|-----------|--------|--------|----------|-----------------|
| **API quality** | Excellent — REST + Sync APIs, full CRUD, filter syntax [1][2] | Good — REST API, mature, well-documented [20][21] | Limited — "only very basic" per reviews [28] | Comprehensive but complex (Graph API) [23] |
| **Auth complexity** | Low — API token or simple OAuth [3] | Low — API key + token, scope=read [21] | Medium — OAuth2 with app registration [22] | High — Azure AD, 7-step setup [19] |
| **Rate limits** | 1000/15min REST, 50/min Sync [10][2] | 300/10s per key, 100/10s per token [20] | Not documented [22] | Graph API limits (varies) [23] |
| **MCP stars** | 409 (official) + 187 (community) [14][15] | 287 [18] | No notable server | 49 [19] |
| **MCP tools** | Curated (official) / 19 (community) [14][15] | Full board ops [18] | N/A | 15 [19] |
| **MCP last active** | Same day [14] / 19 days [15] | 54 days [18] | N/A | 4+ months [19] |
| **Read-only support** | data:read scope [3] | scope=read token [21] | tasks:read scope [32] | Tasks.Read permission [19] |
| **Data model fit** | Excellent for personal tasks [34] | Poor — kanban, not task lists [25][29] | Good — similar to Todoist [28] | Adequate — basic tasks + lists [33] |
| **Free tier** | 5 projects, 3 filters, no reminders [4] | 10 boards [24] | Unlimited tasks, 9 lists [43] | Free with MS account [33] |
| **Pro features** | 300 projects, 150 filters, reminders [4] | Unlimited boards [24] | Enhanced stats, smart lists [43] | Included with M365 [33] |
| **Paid price** | ~$5/mo (est.) [4] | ~$5/user/mo [24] | ~$3/mo [43] | Free [33] |

## Todoist

**Strengths:**
- Only vendor with an officially maintained MCP server [14]
- Best API documentation and developer tooling [1][3]
- Filter query syntax enables sophisticated task queries via API [7]
- Natural language quick_add endpoint [1]
- 80+ official integrations [26]
- Official Python and JavaScript SDKs [28]

**Weaknesses:**
- Free tier limited (3 filters, no reminders) [4]
- Pro required for full PA utility [4]

## Trello

**Strengths:**
- Mature API with good documentation [20][21]
- Strong MCP server (287 stars, MCP Registry listed) [18]
- Native read-only token support [21]
- Visual kanban useful for workflow-based task tracking [25]

**Weaknesses:**
- Board/card/list model is fundamentally designed for kanban project management,
  not personal task lists [25][29]
- No native priorities or due date filtering [31]
- No recurring tasks in free tier [31]
- Limited reporting without Power-Ups [31]
- "Todoist tends to win" for personal task management [29]
- "Clunky on mobile" [30]

## TickTick

**Strengths:**
- Habit tracking (60+ pre-built habits) — unique feature [28]
- Built-in Pomodoro timer [28]
- Eisenhower Matrix view [28]
- Calendar view with Google Calendar/Outlook sync [28]
- Generous free tier (unlimited tasks, 9 lists) [43][44]
- Lowest paid price (~$3/mo) [43]

**Weaknesses:**
- API described as "only very basic and not very useful" [28]
- No official SDKs — unofficial Python library only [28]
- No native webhook support found [28]
- Rate limits not documented [22]
- Developer portal JS-rendered, inaccessible to automated tools [22]
- No notable MCP server found
- Fewer integrations than Todoist (80+) [26][28]

## Microsoft To Do

**Strengths:**
- Free with any Microsoft account [33]
- Deep integration with Outlook, Teams, OneDrive [33]
- Cross-platform (Android, iOS, Mac, Windows, web) [33]
- 25 MB file attachments [33]

**Weaknesses:**
- Azure App Registration with 7-step setup for API access [19]
- Access tokens expire after ~1 hour, refresh after 90 days inactivity [23]
- MCP server has only 49 stars and is 4+ months stale (last push 2025-11-10) [19]
- "Full potential realized when integrated with Microsoft services" [33]
- High ecosystem lock-in with "high switching costs" [33]
- Admin consent required for API permissions [19]
- Not suitable for non-Microsoft-ecosystem users [33]

## Verdict

Todoist is the strongest choice for PA integration based on:

1. **API quality**: best-documented, most capable API with filter syntax [1]
2. **MCP ecosystem**: only vendor-maintained MCP server, actively developed [14]
3. **Auth simplicity**: personal API token works immediately for single-user PA [3]
4. **Data model**: purpose-built for personal task management [34]
5. **Integration breadth**: 80+ integrations, official SDKs [26][28]

TickTick's habit tracking is the only feature Todoist lacks that could be valuable
for a personal PA, but the weak API makes integration impractical.

## Gaps and Limitations

- TickTick developer portal content inaccessible (JavaScript-rendered) [22]
- Exact pricing for Todoist Pro and Business not confirmed from pricing page [4]
- MCP server star counts for TickTick community servers not verified
- Trello MCP server feature parity with Todoist MCP not deeply compared
